retrievalLimitations: No PTCG Live behavior, Chinese translation, image, card name or community source is used as rule authority.
This source record is international only and does not assert Chinese or Japanese historical-format equivalence.
Every real card remains unavailable until its complete official text, timing and legality are audited.
implementationLimits: Supports BASIC, EVOLUTION, STAGE1 and STAGE2 selectors only when the authoritative card definition and CombatProfile evolution chain are present and acyclic.
Candidates are server-filtered before the prompt and server-revalidated after selection; missing or invalid chains fail closed.
Does not implement Rosa's Encouragement, arbitrary multi-target energy allocation, Level-Up, BREAK, V-UNION, devolution or historical evolution exceptions.
